kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the four sections (oncogenic microbes, serum tumor markers, cancer testing, IHC stains); the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis rule (the marker axis: serum tumor markers and their cancer associations; the IHC axis: immunohistochemical stains and their tissue targets) — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the sections sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (MARKER MONITOR NOT DIAGNOSE / ONCOGENIC MICROBES EIGHT / IHC TISSUE OF ORIGIN / MDR1 P-GLYCOPROTEIN PUMP) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 222-223 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on either page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for both pdf 244 and pdf 245). The pages are pure text — four sections: (1) oncogenic microbes (8 microbes), (2) serum tumor markers (12 markers with associations and notes), (3) cancer testing (4 tests + liquid biopsy), (4) important immunohistochemical stains (10 stains with targets and tumors identified) + P-glycoprotein. The visual is an ORIGINAL KYP adaptation rendering the four sections as grid maps (no source figure to redraw). The tables are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No copyrighted photographs; no margin mnemonics (VLM confirmed); the KYP memory layer is original.
